Reason: The CT images (Figures 1a and 1b) demonstrate a mediastinal abscess with air pockets adjacent to the aorta and a large right pleural effusion, which are characteristic findings of an aorto-oesophageal fistula; option A correctly describes the progression of these specific pathological features (increasing effusion and mediastinal air) compared to the other choices which suggest improvement or incorrect laterality.
